title: Ignore the details early on
coreMove: Defer details that depend on structure you have not built; a color or label has no right answer until the core exists, so early polish decides blind and gets redone.

exampleSpecs.audience: teams debating details before a build exists
exampleSpecs.stakes: settle the color now or build the core first
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist refuses a detail debate that has no buildable referent

exampleSpecs.audience: designers polishing before the layout settles
exampleSpecs.stakes: polish the panel now or wait until it survives
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: early refinement is discarded when the structure changes

exampleSpecs.audience: teams trusting a spec to name the right details
exampleSpecs.stakes: specify every detail up front or let use reveal them
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the right details surface through use, not advance reasoning

exampleSpecs.audience: teams mistaking detail motion for real progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: stay busy on settings or face the unresolved core
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: concrete detail work hides the unaddressed hard question

exampleSpecs.stakes: polish in parallel from day one or after coherence holds
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: broad usefulness and coherence come before fine polish

exampleSpecs.audience: makers worried that deferring means shipping careless work
exampleSpecs.stakes: skip details entirely or defer them to a later stage
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist separates deferring details from neglecting them

exampleSpecs.audience: teams deciding which details can be safely deferred
exampleSpecs.stakes: defer a detail that is actually the core or fix it now
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist catches a detail that is load-bearing, not deferrable
